errors.text_span: ranges from 0 to 30 (though data points extend to 37, the visible range is 0 to 37)
errors.evidence: The description of the x-axis range is confusing and inaccurate. The tick labels range up to 30, but the data extends to 37 and the visible axis range extends to approximately 40. Stating that the axis 'ranges from 0 to 30' or that the 'visible range is 0 to 37' are both incorrect.
The value on the plot at x=2 is visibly higher than 0.30. It is approximately 0.33, which is about one-third of the way between the 0.25 and 0.50 gridlines.
